# aether_webhooks (Data Source)

Every webhook of the provider's organization. Signing secrets are never listed: the API returns a secret only when a webhook is created or its secret rotated.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `webhooks` (Attributes List) The webhooks, in the API's order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhooks))

<a id="nestedatt--webhooks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webhooks`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description (`""` when none).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether deliveries are sent.
- `events` (Set of String) Subscribed event types (`*` = all).
- `id` (String) Webhook UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last write time (RFC 3339); a secret rotation moves it too.
- `url` (String) Delivery URL.
